name: template-workspace
description: acerola-ticket — Nest de um lado, React do outro, SQLite no meio.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @template/shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w @template/shared && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e -w server && npm run test:e2e -w client
scripts.test:mutation: npm run test:mutation -w @template/shared && npm run test:mutation -w server && npm run test:mutation -w client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @template/shared && npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w client
scripts.format: npm run format -w @template/shared && npm run format -w server && npm run format -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @template/shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client && tsc -p scripts
